in_marathi.name: Tanirika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Tanu's Radiance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tanirika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tanirika is a Sanskrit name derived from the name of the goddess Tanu. The name signifies the radiance or brilliance of the goddess. In Hindu mythology, Tanu is the wife of King Bhishma and is considered a symbol of purity and grace. The name is also believed to bring blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
